question: Do has/had and is/was use a shared weight-realized L9H1/H4 value subspace, or the same reader weights on task-specific value axes?

searched: MLP4 H1 H4 bank routing local value
prior_art_search.relation: Both tasks independently use MLP4-driven local L9 values through H1/H4, while their final-residual DAS axes have absolute cosine 0.244 and asymmetric transfer. No live L9 value-space intersection/complement test exists.

frozen_design.coordinates: Concatenate the raw L9 c_v changes of H1 and H4 at every declared contextual source-bank position into a common 256-dimensional weight coordinate system; multiply by the fixed (1-lambda9) factor only at causal installation.
frozen_design.fit_split: Within A1 of each task, alternate occurrences separately within reciprocal directions. Fit uses 16 has/had and 8 is/was rows; the other 16/8 A1 rows and all 32/16 A2 rows remain sealed.
frozen_design.task_bases: Geometrically orient reciprocal row changes and choose the smallest SVD rank retaining >=95% fit energy separately for each task.
frozen_design.joint_basis: Give the two task fit matrices equal Frobenius weight, concatenate them, and choose the smallest >=95%-energy basis.
frozen_design.shared_basis: Take principal-vector midpoints only for cross-task principal cosines >=0.80; if none exist, shared rank is exactly zero.
frozen_design.causal_operator: Under frozen base attention patterns, install the projected local value change into L9H1/H4 at the query and run the real suffix. This matches the already identified dominant operation and does not use evaluation outcomes to choose axes.
frozen_design.fit: SVD/principal angles on fit activations only; no gradients, fitted scalar gains, or model updates

predictions.pred_a_authority_capability_capture_and_: all hashes, native cells, factor captures, stratified splits, and price pass
predictions.pred_b_each_task_basis_is_sufficient: own-basis recovery is [0.80,1.20] of exact value on every heldout A1/A2 task panel
predictions.pred_c_shared_geometric_mode_exists: shared rank >=1 and each task heldout matrix retains >=0.30 energy in the other task basis
predictions.pred_d_shared_mode_is_causally_material: shared-basis recovery is >=0.40 of exact value on every heldout A1/A2 task panel
predictions.pred_e_task_specific_complements_are_sec: own-complement absolute recovery is <=0.40 of exact value on every panel
predictions.pred_f_joint_basis_is_compact_and_suffic: joint rank is below the sum of task ranks and joint recovery is [0.80,1.20] of exact value on every panel

terminal_rules.invalid: authority, capability, capture, split, closure, coverage, or price fails
terminal_rules.screen: all predictions pass: promote a shared weight-realized value subspace plus secondary task branches
terminal_rules.null: valid result rejects shared-subspace dominance; retain the shared reader operation but type its value axes by task

interpretation_limits: A shared L9 value subspace is distinct from the already dissimilar final answer-actuator axes.
The same c_v and c_proj weights do not by themselves prove the tasks use the same subspace; shared geometry and causal installation must both pass.
Temporal will/had is added only after this MLP4-matched comparison resolves, because its upstream writer differs.
